title: Claude Code User Configuration (~/.claude.json)
description: User-level configuration file for Claude Code CLI, stored at ~/.claude.json. Contains authentication state, UI preferences, feature flags, usage counters, and per-project settings.

numStartups.description: Number of times Claude Code has been started

autoUpdatesProtectedForNative.description: Whether auto-updates are protected for native installs

showTurnDuration.description: Show turn duration message after responses (e.g., "Cooked for 1m 6s")

hasSeenTasksHint.description: Whether the tasks hint has been shown

hasUsedStash.description: Whether the user has used the stash feature

hasUsedBackslashReturn.description: Whether the user has used backslash-return input

queuedCommandUpHintCount.description: Number of times the queued command up-arrow hint has been shown

diffTool.description: Diff tool to use for displaying changes

approved.description: List of approved custom API key hashes

rejected.description: List of rejected custom API key hashes

env.description: Environment variables to set for Claude Code sessions

tipsHistory.description: History of tips that have been shown

memoryUsageCount.description: Number of times memory has been used

promptQueueUseCount.description: Number of times prompt queue has been used

btwUseCount.description: Number of times BTW (by-the-way) suggestions have been used

messageIdleNotifThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds of idle time before showing a notification

fileCheckpointingEnabled.description: Enable file checkpointing for code rewind

respectGitignore.description: Whether file picker should respect .gitignore files

apiKeyHelper.description: Path to a script that outputs authentication values

shiftEnterKeyBindingInstalled.description: Whether Shift+Enter key binding has been installed

taskCompleteNotifEnabled.description: Enable notification when a task completes

inputNeededNotifEnabled.description: Enable notification when input is needed

hasCompletedClaudeInChromeOnboarding.description: Whether Claude-in-Chrome onboarding has been completed

lspRecommendationNeverPlugins.description: List of LSP plugin names to never recommend

lspRecommendationIgnoredCount.description: Number of times LSP recommendations have been dismissed

remoteControlAtStartup.description: Enable Remote Control for all sessions

remoteDialogSeen.description: Whether the remote control dialog has been seen

hasCompletedOnboarding.description: Whether the user has completed onboarding

awsAuthRefresh.description: Path to a script that refreshes AWS authentication

awsCredentialExport.description: Path to a script that exports AWS credentials

otelHeadersHelper.description: Path to a script that outputs OpenTelemetry headers

allow.description: List of permission rules for allowed operations

deny.description: List of permission rules for denied operations

ask.description: List of permission rules that should always prompt for confirmation

defaultMode.description: Default permission mode when Claude Code needs access

disableBypassPermissionsMode.description: Disable the ability to bypass permission prompts

additionalDirectories.description: Additional directories to include in the permission scope

headersHelper.description: Path to a script that outputs headers
Path to a script that outputs headers
Path to a script that outputs headers

mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations keyed by server name

claudeAiMcpEverConnected.description: List of Claude.ai MCP servers that have been connected

teammateMode.description: How to spawn teammates: "tmux" for traditional tmux, "in-process" for same process, "auto" to choose automatically

alwaysThinkingEnabled.description: When false, thinking is disabled. When absent or true, thinking is enabled automatically.

fastMode.description: When true, fast mode is enabled

fastModePerSessionOptIn.description: When true, fast mode does not persist across sessions

promptSuggestionEnabled.description: When false, prompt suggestions are disabled

showThinkingSummaries.description: Show thinking summaries in the transcript view

skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt.description: Whether the user has accepted the bypass permissions mode dialog

skipAutoPermissionPrompt.description: Whether the user has accepted the auto mode opt-in dialog

bypassPermissionsModeAccepted.description: Whether bypass permissions mode has been accepted

penguinModeOrgEnabled.description: Whether penguin mode is enabled for the organization

preferTmuxOverIterm2.description: Prefer tmux over iTerm2 for terminal management

iterm2It2SetupComplete.description: Whether iTerm2 IT2 setup has been completed

showSpinnerTree.description: Show spinner tree view for teammates

prefersReducedMotion.description: Reduce or disable animations for accessibility

firstStartTime.description: Unix timestamp of the first startup

claudeCodeFirstTokenDate.description: Date string of when the first token was used

startupPrefetchedAt.description: Unix timestamp of the last startup prefetch

lastShownEmergencyTip.description: ID of the last shown emergency tip

transcriptShareDismissed.description: Whether the transcript share prompt has been dismissed

hasAcknowledgedCostThreshold.description: Whether the user has acknowledged the cost threshold

hasResetAutoModeOptInForDefaultOffer.description: Whether auto mode opt-in has been reset for the default offer

hasVisitedPasses.description: Whether the user has visited the passes page

opusProMigrationComplete.description: Whether Opus Pro migration has been completed

sonnet1m45MigrationComplete.description: Whether Sonnet 1M 4.5 migration has been completed

sonnet45To46MigrationTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp of when Sonnet 4.5 to 4.6 migration occurred

skillUsage.description: Per-skill usage tracking keyed by skill name

githubRepoPaths.description: GitHub repository paths keyed by repo identifier

cachedChromeExtensionInstalled.description: Whether the Chrome extension is detected as installed

cachedExtraUsageDisabledReason.description: Cached reason for extra usage being disabled

groveConfigCache.description: Cached Grove configuration keyed by identifier

passesUpsellSeenCount.description: Number of times the passes upsell has been shown

desktopUpsellSeenCount.description: Number of times the desktop upsell has been shown

githubActionSetupCount.description: Number of times GitHub Action setup has been prompted

ideHintShownCount.description: Number of times IDE hint has been shown

slackAppInstallCount.description: Number of times Slack app install has been prompted

subscriptionNoticeCount.description: Number of times subscription notice has been shown

voiceNoticeSeenCount.description: Number of times voice notice has been shown

opus1mMergeNoticeSeenCount.description: Number of times Opus 1M merge notice has been shown

autoPermissionsNotificationCount.description: Number of times auto permissions notification has been shown

mcpContextUris.description: MCP context URIs for this project

enabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of approved MCP servers from .mcp.json

disabledMcpjsonServers.description: List of rejected MCP servers from .mcp.json

hasTrustDialogAccepted.description: Whether the trust dialog has been accepted for this project

projectOnboardingSeenCount.description: Number of times project onboarding has been shown

hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesApproved.description: Whether external includes in CLAUDE.md have been approved

hasClaudeMdExternalIncludesWarningShown.description: Whether the external includes warning has been shown

hasCompletedProjectOnboarding.description: Whether project-specific onboarding has been completed

additionalProperties.description: Per-project configuration keyed by sanitized project path
